target_customer.value: Freelance designers in Egypt and the wider MENA region who work with several clients at once

problem.value: Freelance graphic designers in Egypt struggle to track client projects, invoices sent, and revision rounds.

product_type.value: A digital template pack (Notion and Google Sheets)

founder_skills.value: 4 years as a freelance designer; comfortable with Notion, Google Sheets and Canva; no coding

distribution_channel.value: Sell through a website with a one-time purchase link

differentiation.value: Bilingual Arabic and English, built for local freelancing habits

values_and_limits.value: Bilingual (Arabic and English). No subscriptions that lock users in. Will not collect client data

options: Sell through a website with a one-time purchase link
Offer via social media groups in Arabic and English
Partner with local design communities for direct distribution
decisions.value: Sell through a website with a one-time purchase link
